title: 洛杉矶与佛州学区面临预算压力
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Today, we're looking at two school systems who are facing heightened financial pressures, one on each coast.
segments.zh: 今天，我们关注两个面临较大财务压力的学校系统，分别位于东西海岸。

segments.en: The Los Angeles Unified School District has a high fiscal solvency risk level as its enrollment continues to decline.
segments.zh: 洛杉矶联合学区因入学人数持续下降，财政偿付风险较高。

segments.en: Meanwhile, you look at Florida and that states public schools are borrowing to pay their bills at the highest level on record.
segments.zh: 与此同时，佛罗里达州公立学校的借款规模达到历史最高水平。

segments.en: Here now with all the details are Bloomberg Mutian reporters, Claire Valentine and Erin Hudson.
segments.zh: 彭博记者克莱尔·瓦伦丁和艾琳·哈德森带来详细报道。

segments.en: So, Claire, let me start with you because the LA Union Free School District, I believe, is considered the biggest school district in the country.
segments.zh: 克莱尔，先从你开始，洛杉矶联合学区据说是全国最大的学区。

segments.en: What's the financial situation there right now? Yeah, so some of the pressures that they're facing are pretty emblematic of what's happening across the country.
segments.zh: 目前那里的财务状况如何？他们面临的一些压力，正是全国情况的缩影。

segments.en: So, one of the big overarching issues is just that the number of school-age kids is shrinking due to the birth rate dropping.
segments.zh: 一个主要问题是，由于出生率下降，学龄儿童数量正在减少。

segments.en: So, there are just less students to fill classrooms, which really impacts how much funding they can get because it's often on a poor people basis.
segments.zh: 学生少了，教室空置，这直接影响拨款，因为拨款常按学生人数计算。

segments.en: And LA, also, you have other factors going on, you have, because of some of the immigration rates, you have people keeping their kids home, also seeing some people leave the area for
segments.zh: 洛杉矶还有其他因素，比如移民政策导致一些家庭让孩子留在家中，也有人因生活成本离开。

segments.en: a lower cost of living, all of that is contributing to these decreases in enrollment.
segments.zh: 这些都在导致入学人数下降。

segments.en: You also had an LA, they recently had a negotiation with their unions and they avoided a strike, but they did approve wage increases, which further puts pressure on their budgets.
segments.zh: 洛杉矶也面临类似情况，他们最近与工会谈判避免了罢工，但批准了加薪，这进一步加大了预算压力。

segments.en: Okay, and I made my mistake. The LA Unified School District is the second largest after New York City, which I should have known.
segments.zh: 好的，我犯了个错误。洛杉矶联合学区是仅次于纽约市的第二大学区，我本该知道这一点。
